detail.longDescription: The scanner puts half the pages sideways, and fixing it costs you an upload to a random website. PDFCheetah rotates selected pages or the whole document, left, right or 180 degrees, with a preview so you can check before saving. This is the one tool we have tested end to end with the connection off. It works, because the work was never happening on a server. Chrome is the only browser checked so far. https://www. pdfcheetah.com/rotate-pdf # PDF # Privacy # WebApps # Productivity
